verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an email and productivity platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only event-triggered automation (Inbox rules acting on incoming mail, change-notification subscriptions) and a one-off "create a draft to send later." None of these is a recurring schedule, and an event trigger or a one-off action cannot stand in for one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
